author: Polar_Express
body:
Hiya!

For your consideration: Icy (Ver 1.0) - A walls map.

This map is unique as it has 4 equally sized and resourced quads, but with different shapes. The map is set on a Frozen plain in a shelter. The middle I think works pretty good, and with the walls down it offers a very original play style when compared to other maps. The quads are about the same size as normal quads ( 5x5 bigger at max) with a slightly bigger middle than we see on most maps. The diamond amount is on par with that of a Tetris map.

The map is much more detailed than what the pics show. Please give it a look, it is worth downloading before posting.

Map Pics: http://imgur.com/a/TzLoA
Map Download with YML: https://www.dropbox.com/s/rq5l1ysax06ofea/icy.zip?dl=0
Map YML: Only: https://www.dropbox.com/s/wfnp8718jcol9cc/map.yml?dl=0

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
before you read this- i know i don't usually do comments this long on maps, but i have a bunch of time on my hands and will probably be giving more info to ppl who make maps about why i like or dislike them now because it really helps the person out.



pros:
-snow hills look cool

-provides essential aspects of the game, including a mine, trees for wood, some terrain, at least some pluses in the middle that encourage players to go there, etc.

-gameplay is not bad! the ice is good for slippy slidey, the terrain is cool, the house is nice.


cons:
-looks too blocky in many parts (the icy structure in the middle, the mines, parts of the house)

-lacks great aesthetics, outer walls are made completely out of ice... at least use the default outer wall and edit the blocks on it to match your map... walls are not detailed, all gravel is not at all pleasing to the eye. i know there are maps with all sand walls but that doesn't look so harsh.

-parts in the middle look uneven (this one you can prove me wrong on, i'm not 100% sure about it but it just looks that way from the pics)

-this is very minor and unimportant, but personally i'm not feeling the name.

-the quadrants look too empty. add more structure, there is a lot you can do with an ice map! the ice walls in the icy river look kind of random and not great for it, although may be better for pvp. to fix this, i'd add some to the base to make it look more like a spike than a random wall jutting up. maybe add a couple more glowstone lamps. also, there is too much concentrated packed ice. maybe add some snow here and there or some normal ice. 



all in all.. could use work. i wouldn't rush this map as it does have potential and deserves the best you can do. i've played the maps you have in rotation, and most of them are hella awesome! add more to the middle. create the outer walls, those are important aesthetic parts, don't just use one block and call it good. 
basically, it kind of looks like more of a nebula map. idk if that makes sense.

good luck! :)

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Ok few things - 

If you have ever played the nexus maps , the amout of ice can be a good thing. 

 I don't build maps to circumvent x-ray people. If you try and mine to make a full set of armor , you will see that the amout of ore is fine, the ratio of coal and gold makes how the ore is distributed just fine and many will think there are not enough. Less could  really slow game play down. 

The theam of the map is to give more detail to the land and play area, I see no need to have random structures in the middle of a frozen wasteland, just to have them. The middle is built to pvp, the walls are needed due to having a punch bow + ice. You just have to have it. The middle structure is supposed to look blocky... It's ice, and adding more detail, took away from making you feel like you were playing in a cross section of a frozen wasteland , not on a standard walls map.

the bedrock between quads is not really needed, the bedrock is not what stops players from digging to other quads pre-match. The walls plugin does that. After the match starts its fair game, this is by design. As for wall height, anyone can build and shoot over any wall. 

The walls border is all ice , and bedrock, to give it an enclosed feel. Having a pretty outer wall just didnt fit for the the far away wasteland feel. As for it being blocky, it's minecraft with a " snow theme, that's built for the "out in the wilderness feel",I wanted to do a lot with that. 

Thanks for the thoughts

if the map devs like it enough to accept it, I'll work on a  few additions , maybe an ice bridge or two across the quads that could use it, but I really think it has more detail and gameplay than "the walls" and "jungle", and is much more unique. Players have been asking for fun maps that keep to the basics and are not as complicated. - this is a shot in that direction. If the only thing stopping it from being accepted is the gravel walls or border walls, we can cross that path when we get there.
